state_and_ownership.bounds: Count and retained-original bytes separately bounded. Encoded header <= one native frame and original-coordinate range vector <=256 per flow. Lower physical originals retain existing finite-queue bound.
state_and_ownership.continuation: First matched ACK gates subsequent emission; effective gap after prior completion. Copied flow tokens are re-found after observations/callbacks. No packet dereference after lower push.
state_and_ownership.deadline: Fixed admission-to-delivery deadline; fresh prepared envelope clipped to it. Saturated effective-clock conversion/addition; protection >= saturated(residence+60s). Exact expiry is checked before admission and completion independent of timer order.
state_and_ownership.lifecycle: Whole Layer cleanup cancels timers/ownership; native false result cancels even when readiness forbids continuation. Interface-table own-NIC DOWN cancels pause-phase work. Weak notification reference/unsubscribe protects helper lifetime; no destructor callbacks.
state_and_ownership.modes: Default off, native only, explicit Mesh rejection. Only fragmented ordinary native unicast paced. RS/RA/NS/NA/Redirect/DAR/DAC and broadcast immediate. Frozen context interpretation survives after accepted FRAG1.
state_and_ownership.source_helper: Owns immutable original/header/ranges/native tuple per admitted flow, at most one lower original in flight. No stored lower packet pointer. Explicit local frame IDs correlate the native borrowed-original callback. Admission observers borrow a locally owned packet snapshot that survives synchronous flow cancellation.
